dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK, Nam. The form asks about your work experience. How many jobs have you had so far?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, ˈnɑːm. ðə ˈfɔːrm ˈæsks əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈwɜːrk ɪkˌspɪriəns. ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈdʒɑːbz hæv juː ˈhæd soʊ ˈfɑːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Three. I've worked at a restaurant, a supermarket and a travel company.
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː. aɪv ˈwɜːrkt ət ə ˈrɛstərɑːnt, ə ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt ənd ə ˈtrævəl ˈkʌmpəni.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And what qualifications do you have?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt ˌkwɑːlɪfɪˈkeɪʃənz duː juː ˈhæv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'll get my degree in English soon. Up to now, I've passed two English tests with high scores.
dialogue.reading: aɪl ˈɡɛt maɪ dɪˈɡriː ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈsuːn. ˈʌp tə ˈnaʊ, aɪv ˈpæst ˈtuː ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈtɛsts wɪð ˈhaɪ ˈskɔːrz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great. Are you qualified to teach English, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ər juː ˈkwɑːlɪfaɪd tə ˈtiːtʃ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not yet. I need a teaching certificate for that.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt. aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈtiːtʃɪŋ sərˈtɪfɪkət fər ˈðæt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm quite skilled at making videos. I made a lot of them at my internship.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈkwaɪt ˈskɪld ət ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈvɪdioʊz. aɪ ˈmeɪd ə ˈlɑːt əv ðɛm ət maɪ ˈɪntɜːrnʃɪp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How many projects have you worked on so far?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈprɑːdʒɛkts hæv juː ˈwɜːrkt ˈɑːn soʊ ˈfɑːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Three: two at my internship and one for a class at university.
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː: ˈtuː ət maɪ ˈɪntɜːrnʃɪp ənd ˈwʌn fər ə ˈklæs ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Perfect! You're more qualified than you think.
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrfɪkt! jʊr ˈmɔːr ˈkwɑːlɪfaɪd ðən juː ˈθɪŋk.
